verdict.rationale: Mollie is a REST API-first payment platform with documented API keys, idempotency headers, webhooks, and test mode—all usable headlessly/in CI without any UI—so server-to-server automation is clearly supported. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, no official CLI, and no SDK/pipeline documentation demonstrating scripted or automated test-mode runs in a CI context. missing for 10: no documented CLI or CI/CD pipeline examples, no evidence of automated test suites or GitHub Actions integration, no explicit 'headless' framing beyond general API-first design.
